title: Pangasinan-owned college granted Institutional Recognition by CHED

blocks.text: LINGAYEN, Pangasinan – The Pangasinan Polytechnic College (PPC) has received Institutional Recognition (IR) from the Commission on Higher Education (CHED), less than three years after its inception. PPC President Emeritus Raymundo Rovillos said the IR was the “formal stamp that established PPC as a full-fledged higher education institution, and makes the college eligible for government programs that local universities and colleges cannot access without it.” The programs include CHED’s Unified Student Financial Assistance System for Tertiary Education (UniFAST), which is under the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act (RA 10931).
